info.name: TalkAM API v2
info.description: TalkAM v2 API collection. v2 is a parallel lane mounted at api/v2 — v1 stays untouched. Grown section by section as endpoint shapes freeze.

formdata.description: Optional. Must exist in countries table.

request.description: Registers a user. full_name is split into first/middle/last server-side. Sends a 6-digit email verification OTP. Returns {token, user}.
Reused v1 behavior. Returns {token, user}. Re-sends a verify PIN if email is unverified.
Reused v1 behavior. Auto-creates the user on first provider sign-in.
Public, throttled (30/min). data: {username, available}. Serves the Create Account and anonymous-mode screens.
Sends a 6-digit reset code to the email. Throttled (5/min).
Requires confirmation + strength regex; the new password must differ from the current one. The code is single-use.
Issues a 6-digit email code. Throttled (5/min); the 60s client resend countdown is covered server-side.
Verifies the 6-digit code and sets email_verified_at.
v1 me payload plus a computed data.onboarding object: {user_type, interests, avatar, consents, completed_at}. The app resumes onboarding at the first false step.
The onboarding interest chips (post_categories rows marked type=interest_topic). No parameters.
Batch interest selection from onboarding. Minimum 3 IDs; deduped server-side.
Reused v1 preset avatar list. Public.

formdata.description: Preset avatar id. Skippable — just don't call.

request.description: Reused v1 profile update (also accepts name, username, gender, date_of_birth, ...).
Records onboarding intent only — role stays User.
State of all four consent keys: account_operation, session_delivery (required), anonymous_community, anonymised_research (optional).

First confirm requires both required keys true. Required keys can never be toggled off (400 — that path is account deletion). Optional keys toggle freely; revocation is go-forward (revoked_at set, granted_at preserved).
Stamps users.onboarding_completed_at and returns the derived onboarding object.
Reused v1 privacy policy content. Public.

query.description: Optional topic chip filter (id from interest-topics)

request.description: Interest-category posts first (recency-ordered), backfilled with popular recent posts. Paginated; impressions logged.
Engagement-ranked (comments + likes) over the recent 2-month window.
Reused v1 post detail (Read More). Logs click + recent view.
Reused v1 reaction toggle.
Reused v1 stats tracking (shares, engagements, clicks...).
Reused v1 stats fetch.
Gates the check-in modal: data = {checked_in, mood, checked_in_on}.
One check-in per calendar day; a same-day repeat updates the row.
Reused v1 announcements — serves the server-controlled therapist prompt banner.

body.raw:
{
  "category_id": 12,
  "type": "Text",
  "title": "Managing anxiety day to day",
  "body": "Max 500 chars.",
  "tags": ["anxiety"],
  "is_anonymous": 0,
  "status": "Active",
  "publish_at": null
}

request.description: v2 rules: title required, tags min 1, body <= 500 chars, category_id must be an interest topic. status=Scheduled + publish_at schedules; followers are notified of non-anonymous published posts.
500-char server max; threading/mentions/anonymous reuse v1 logic.
v1 listing plus muted users excluded.
Reused v1 toggle.
Requires comment_id AND post_id (v1 contract).
Hides the post from the caller's v2 feeds. data.not_interested reflects the new state.
Subscribe to an author — notified of their new non-anonymous posts. data.following reflects the new state.
Feeds-only: hides their posts/comments from your v2 feeds. DMs unaffected (that's Block).
Reused v1 block toggle.
Reused v1 drafts (status=Drafted). Full apiResource registered (index/show/update/destroy).
Reused v1 guidelines list.
Public: guests only see open-access groups. Authenticated: v1 behavior.
Reused v1 show: description, about, can_post, group_access, owner, total_members.
Subscribe = Join (membership, role Member). Idempotent.
Lighter follow — updates without membership (Follow != Join).
Organic: interest match first, then member count; excludes joined + closed groups.
Creates an invitations row with group_id. Returns the invite uuid.
Join semantics — creates membership for the invitee (email must match).

query.description: post | people | groups (v1 values also accepted)

request.description: People results carry is_following; group results carry is_member; post tab includes related_topics (interest-topic name matches). Queries are logged to recent searches.
Reused v1 recent views (supports group_id).
Status + derived per-step completeness map {personal, documents, specialties, availability, payout}. Resume at the first false.
Creates/updates the draft. Session rate here is ignored (Payout-step only).
One document per call; re-upload of the same type replaces it.
Specialty ids are interest-topic ids (GET /api/v2/user/interest-topics).
Duration/buffer values are config-driven presets. Per-day toggle = active on/off.
Flutterwave bank list, cached 6h.
Live Flutterwave resolution — returns account_name, persists nothing.
Re-verifies the account server-side and saves it with the session rate. No BVN collected or stored.
Validates all steps complete; draft -> submitted; 3-5 business day review.
Cards: name, verified flag, credential, specialties, rate, rating + review count, next available slot.
Bio, specialties, session_formats, fee, completed sessions, ratings histogram, next slot.
Computed: availability window / (duration + buffer) minus held/confirmed bookings.
pending_payment with a 15-min slot hold. Amount computed server-side from the therapist's stored rate.
Creates a PAYMENT_FOR_SESSION payments row and returns the Flutterwave checkout payload. Retry allowed for failed bookings.
Verifies via Flutterwave then dispatches by activity. Session success -> booking confirmed + notifications; failure -> booking failed, slot freed.
data = {upcoming: [], past: []} for the caller only.
Includes format, duration, amount and the payment reference (transaction id).
Completed sessions only; one review per session; always displayed anonymised.
Paginated, anonymised authors, plus a 1-5 star histogram.
Payment reference/amount/fees + session date/format/therapist. Paid bookings only.
Policy: client >=24h before start -> full refund; inside 24h -> no refund; therapist-initiated -> always refunds. Slot freed.
Max 2 requests per session, 6h cutoff (config). Counterpart accepts or declines.
Accept moves the slot at the same price — never a payment delta.
Short-lived AV token + channel_ref (Agora). Time/status gated; first join stamps in_progress.
HMAC-verified call-state events; room_closed stamps ended_at and auto-completes.
